# CLI reference

**Who this is for:** anyone running `tfgen` directly, or reading a pipeline invocation.

> Generated from the cobra command tree in `internal/cli/` by `cmd/tfgen-docs`. Edit that source and run `make tfgen-docs`; changes made here are overwritten.

tfgen is invoked through a single binary. Build it with `make tfgen-build` (which
writes `bin/tfgen`) and run it from the provider checkout root.

Every flag below is read from the command tree at generation time, so this inventory
cannot drift from the flags actually registered. Flags marked **inert** are accepted
without error but not yet acted on — they are still part of the contract, because
passing one neither fails nor does anything.

## Exit codes

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `0` | The command completed and, in `--check` mode, found nothing to change. |
| `1` | The command failed: parsing, generation, validation, I/O, or report writing. |
| `3` | `generate --check` found generated files or wiring that would change. |

Exit code `2` is not used. See [Interpreting a failed run](diagnostics.md).

## Global flags

Accepted by every subcommand.

| Flag | Type | Default | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--quiet` | `bool` | `false` | **Inert.** Accepted; informational logging is not yet suppressed. |

`--version` prints the generator version; `--help` prints command help.

## `tfgen generate`

Generate Terraform artifacts from the OpenAPI spec.

| Flag | Type | Default | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--check` | `bool` | `false` | Read-only mode: exit 3 if any file would change |
| `--docs-root` | `string` | `docs/data-sources` | Root directory for data-source docs pages (used when retiring) |
| `--emit-tests` | `bool` | `false` | Also emit a generated acceptance-test scaffold for each data source |
| `--examples-output-root` | `string` | `examples/data-sources` | Root directory for generated data-source examples |
| `--hooks-root` | `string` | `datadog/fwprovider/hooks` | **Inert.** Accepted; hook discovery is not yet implemented. |
| `--include` | `string` | _empty_ | Comma-separated artifact names to generate (empty = all) |
| `--max-depth` | `int` | `20` | Hard limit on recursive $ref expansion |
| `--output-root` | `string` | `datadog/fwprovider` | Root directory for generated artifacts |
| `--reconcile` | `bool` | `false` | Retire generated data sources no longer annotated (requires the full spec; incompatible with --include) |
| `--report` | `string` | `-` | Where to write the run report ("-" = stdout) |
| `--retire` | `string` | _empty_ | Comma-separated artifact names to retire without generating (deletes files + registration) |
| `--spec` | `string` | `.generator/V2/openapi.yaml` | OpenAPI spec to read |
| `--tests-output-root` | `string` | `datadog/tests` | Root directory for generated acceptance-test files |
| `--tracking-field` | `string` | `x-datadog-tf-generator` | OpenAPI extension name for the tracking field |

## `tfgen split`

Split an aggregate generated push into per-artifact bundles.

| Flag | Type | Default | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--base-dir` | `string` | _empty_ | Checkout of the base branch the push is diffed against (required) |
| `--check` | `bool` | `false` | Plan and report without writing the output bundles |
| `--generated-dir` | `string` | _empty_ | Checkout of the pushed branch carrying the generated artifacts (required) |
| `--generation-report` | `string` | _empty_ | Upstream tfgen generate report used to authorize retirement and blocked routing |
| `--out` | `string` | _empty_ | Directory to receive one bundle per artifact (required) |
| `--report` | `string` | `-` | Where to write the split report ("-" = stdout) |

## `tfgen verify`

Run post-generation checks without writing files.

> **Not implemented.** Registered but not implemented: it performs no checks and returns success. Do not treat a passing `tfgen verify` as evidence of anything.

| Flag | Type | Default | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--strict` | `bool` | `false` | **Inert.** Accepted; `verify` performs no checks, so there is nothing to escalate. |
